title: Premium plan
text: The Premium plan costs 9.99 euros per month. It includes card payments in foreign currencies with no fee, travel insurance, and two free ATM withdrawals abroad per month.

title: Customer base
text: In September 2026 the bank had 182,000 active customers, of whom 14% were on the Premium plan. 61% of customers are aged 25 to 44.

title: Complaints, third quarter of 2026
text: The bank received 1,240 complaints between July and September 2026: 38% about card delivery, 22% about blocked cards, 15% about transfers and 25% about other topics.

title: Mobile app
text: In September 2026 the mobile app was rated 4.3 out of 5 in the app stores. The features customers request most are budgeting tools and instant notifications for card payments.

title: Product roadmap 2027
text: Planned for 2027: an AI assistant called Nova in the app in the first quarter, budgeting tools in the second quarter, and a joint account in the second half of the year.

title: Foreign currency
text: Card payments in a foreign currency use the Mastercard exchange rate plus a 1.5% fee. The fee is waived for Premium customers.

title: Card delivery
text: New cards arrive within 7 working days. If a card has not arrived after 10 working days, the customer can order a free replacement in the app under Card > Replace.

title: Blocked PIN
text: After three wrong PIN attempts the card is blocked. The customer can unblock it in the app under Card > PIN > Unblock, or at any of the bank's ATMs.

title: Transfer limits
text: Customers can send up to 10,000 euros per day by SEPA transfer. Instant transfers are limited to 2,000 euros each.

title: AI assistant policy
text: The support chatbot must start every conversation with: 'You are chatting with Nova, the bank's AI assistant.' Staff must never paste customer names, IBANs or card numbers into external AI tools.
